settings.tmdb.title: Metadata
settings.tmdb.sentDesc: Your public IP address goes too, like any web request
settings.tmdb.lookupText: Search words and IDs of what a page shows.
settings.tmdb.headersText: Accept, Cache-Control, If-None-Match and X-Fetch: ahead when a page is loaded ahead of time.
settings.tmdb.countryText: Installs are counted per country. Turn off Count this install and requests carry X-Country-Count: off.
settings.tmdb.never1: Your files, folder paths or file names.
settings.tmdb.never2: Your library: which titles you have, what is downloading, your history.
settings.tmdb.never3: Accounts: user names, passwords, sign-in sessions, who requested what.
settings.tmdb.never4: Keys and addresses of your Downloaders, Sources, media servers and lists.
settings.tmdb.modeServerAbout: Everything works. Lookups go through our server.
settings.tmdb.modeOwnAbout: Our server is never contacted. Fewer rows on Explore; no charts.
settings.tmdb.modeOffAbout: No lookups. Library, downloads and requests keep working.
settings.tmdb.dockerValue: HOLYARRS_METADATA_MODE is "{value}", which isn't full, own or off, so lookups are off.
settings.tmdb.ownNote: With your own keys, HolyArrs asks each source directly. Music charts, new music rows, streaming Top 10s, Wikipedia facts and anime maps come only from the HolyArrs server, so they are off.
settings.tmdb.keysDesc: Only the TMDB read token is needed
settings.tmdb.tvdbDesc: Optional, for shows that use TheTVDB for details
settings.tmdb.keyTmdbHint: From your TMDB account, under API.
settings.tmdb.keysKept: Keys are kept encrypted. Music asks MusicBrainz, Deezer and Wikipedia directly, one request a second.
settings.tmdb.offDesc: These rows and details don't show
settings.tmdb.hostsDesc: The only outside addresses lookups reach
settings.tmdb.src.tmdb: Movie and show details, search and Explore
settings.tmdb.src.tvmaze: TVmaze show details and air times
settings.tmdb.src.charts: Music charts and new music rows
